vetSays.line: A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with water: +4 clean.
"You haven't earned that yet," A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm says. (Trust too low.)
A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself." The pantry won't fill itself.
You catch fragments by the fire — A person, maybe 20s telling A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm about you. It's barely the same story now. That's what fires do.
A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
You catch fragments by the fire — Luna telling A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm about you. Three retellings in, nobody remembers what actually happened — but everyone has opinions.
You catch fragments by the fire — Mara telling A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm about you. Someone's added a flourish that wasn't there this morning.
💧 A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with water: +3 clean.

You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 30s, with a gap-toothed grin telling A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm about Frieda. The truth left this story two fires ago. What's left is better theater.

You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm telling David about A woman, maybe 30s, with a gap-toothed grin. The truth left this story two fires ago. What's left is better theater.
A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm paces the hall, restless, then sits. Then paces.
...and then it lands: A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm speaks 🇯🇵 Japanese. You share no language at all.
🛡️ Riley, Frieda, Luna and Ahmed met them at the door — 4 put down. Frieda, Luna, Ahmed are hurt.
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
Riley strikes the Scarred The Bailiff.
The Scarred The Bailiff falls.
📺 Riley brought down Scarred The Bailiff. Together. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Riley, Frieda, Luna and Ahmed met them at the door — 4 put down. Riley, Frieda, Ahmed are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sanne just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Luna just put down The Loud Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Luna, Ahmed, Bruno and Mara met them at the door — 4 put down. Luna, Ahmed, Bruno, Mara are hurt.
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
Ahmed strikes the Elder The Union Rep.
The Elder The Union Rep falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Elder The Union Rep!
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sanne just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ava just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Ahmed, Bruno, Sigrun, Sanne and Ava met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 driven off, 2 barely walked away. Ahmed, Bruno, Sigrun, Sanne, Ava are hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ariki just put down The Loud Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Kuzma just put down The Loud Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Kuzma, Dmitri and Sefa met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 barely walked away. Kuzma, Dmitri, Sefa are hurt.
📓 Codex: you've heard of Cold-Blooded. Someone, somewhere, can do this. Now you know its name.
◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Dmitri — Craft 1. Three offers; they took Cold-Blooded. Earned, chosen. (cold_blooded: villager level-up)
📓 Codex: Dmitri chose Cold-Blooded (cold_blooded) at Craft 1.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Dmitri just put down The Loud Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Kuzma, Dmitri, Ariki and Sefa met them at the door — 1 put down, 3 barely walked away. Kuzma, Dmitri, Ariki, Sefa are hurt.
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Dmitri Sokolov, 41 — an appliance repair tech. His hands know different work now: Iron Stomach, Echo Location, Cold-Blooded.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sefa just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Ariki, Sefa, Fátima and Nurlan met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off, 2 barely walked away. Ariki, Sefa, Fátima are hurt.

Nurlan: "Sefa and Ariki blooded the fourth draft's beasts — we all saw it on the cameras. But only 4 of us carry a weapon, and the fifth draft waits until 6 of us do. We need more hands armed, not more speeches."
